name: Nihon Nohyaku Co., Ltd.
summary: Nihon Nohyaku Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells agricultural chemicals in Japan, Asia, North America, Central America, South America, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Pesticides, Chemicals Other Than Pesticides, and Others. It offers crop protection products, including fungicides, insecticides, and herbicides; crop aid and adjuvant products, such as biostimulants, adjuvants, and soil conditioners; termiticides and other chemical products; pharmaceuticals comprising topical antifungal drugs; flea/tick control agents for animals; wood preservatives; and agricultural materials.
